record.one_liner: Twenty is an open-source CRM (cloud or self-hosted) for managing people, companies, opportunities and custom objects, with workflows and AI features.
record.auth_notes: API keys are created in Settings → Developers → API, shown once, can be scoped to a role, and are sent as `Authorization: Bearer KEY`. OAuth is documented for external apps acting on behalf of users, but I did not fetch the OAuth flow page, so the grant details are unverified. The MCP server accepts OAuth (recommended) or an API key.
record.access_notes: The pricing page shows no free Cloud plan, only a 30-day free trial with no credit card. Self-hosting the open-source core is free and gives the same API. Pro ($9/user/mo), Organization ($39/user/mo) and Enterprise (from $50k/yr) include the REST and GraphQL API. I did not confirm that API keys work during the trial, though that is likely. The pricing page was fetched through a summarizer, so confirm the figures on the live page.
record.blocker: There is no permanent free Cloud tier. Cloud needs a paid plan after the 30-day trial, or you self-host. Rate limits are inconsistent across pages: the API docs say 100 requests/min with 60 records per batch, while the pricing page says 50/min on Pro, 100/min on Organization, and custom on Enterprise. I did not verify the OAuth flow details for third-party apps.

evidence.auth: https://docs.twenty.com/developers/extend/api.md (API key sent as a Bearer token, role-scoped; OAuth for external apps, flow not described on that page)
evidence.access: https://twenty.com/pricing (30-day free trial, no free Cloud plan, self-hosting is free, Pro/Organization/Enterprise include the API)
evidence.api: https://docs.twenty.com/developers/extend/api.md (Core REST and GraphQL for People, Companies, Opportunities and custom objects; Metadata API for objects, fields and relations)
evidence.mcp: https://docs.twenty.com/developers/extend/mcp (built-in MCP server at https://{workspace}/mcp with OAuth or API key; tools for records, metadata, workflows and more). The page does not use the word official, but it is vendor documentation and the config is generated in Settings → AI → MCP.
